title: Bichitos Rumble
description: An arena brawler where nine animal characters headbutt each other off a platform. Each critter has its own abilities and an ultimate. Play against bots, online with up to four players, or with friends. No sign-up.
how_to_play: WASD to move, Space to headbutt, J and K for abilities and L for your ultimate. Press R to restart. Knock your rivals off the edge and be the last one standing. Gamepads are supported.
